batch_node.name: Core dimension vocabulary v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Dimension nodes for the dimension keys core itself stamps (req-grid-dimension-core-vocabulary). Dimensions are declared, never created on demand (aws-build Q48a).

node.name: tap.meta
node.description: What kind of grid record a node is, for records that describe the grid itself rather than observe the world. Core stamps it on every Dimension node (value `dimension`) and on the keystone (value `keystone`). Bounded by use, open as declared: core owns the values.

node.name: tap.graph
node.description: Which graph a node belongs to. Core's web layer stamps `web` on its own models and edges (tap_web/dimensions.py), so presentation records partition from observed ones.

node.name: tap_cares
node.description: Which part of the collection machinery (tap_cares) a record belongs to: `collector`, `collection_job`, `schedule`, `schedule_fire`. Core stamps it on tap_cares' own models. Not a dotted name; declared under its current name and renamed later if wanted (a rename is one field update on this node).
